idea-plugin.name: Github Copilot sessions
idea-plugin.description:
Export and import GitHub Copilot chat sessions.
The plugin reads the local Copilot storage (~/.copilot/session-store.db and ~/.copilot/session-state) and the session record the GitHub Copilot plugin keeps inside the IDE, lets you pick the conversations you want to move and writes them into a portable ZIP archive. The same archive can be imported back on another machine or after a workstation reset, restoring the conversation turns, the checkpoints, the session workspace files and the entry shown in the chat history.
  • Tools | Github Copilot sessions | Export Sessions... pick one or more sessions and save the archive.
  • Tools | Github Copilot sessions | Import Sessions... pick an archive and choose which sessions to restore.

Special thanks

A heartfelt thank you to my colleague and dear friend Antonio Petricca, who has followed this plugin since its very early stages: his suggestions shaped the design choices, and his field testing brought to light issues that no unit test would ever have detected. Thank you for the time and care you dedicated to it.
